messages:
alex: Console linter is blocking a save when a route has host: '*' and `overrides.headers`. Is that still intended? Getting ERROR from the parser: 'overrides not allowed for wildcard host'.

alex: example YAML I used:
```yaml
route:
  host: '*'
  path: /v1/*
  overrides:
    headers:
      x-tenant: tenant-a
```

mira: We intentionally disallowed overrides on wildcard hosts a while back to avoid accidental cross-tenant header injection. But agree the UX is rough — should probably be a warn + explain, not hard fail.

cheng: If we relax it we need parser tests and a migration path. Repro steps?

alex: Steps: 1) Console -> New Route. 2) paste YAML above. 3) click save -> lint modal shows ERROR WL-304 and prevents save. Screenshot: https://.../img.png

mira: +1. UX option: convert ERROR -> WARN in console and add an inline "Override anyway" checkbox that inserts a vendor extension like `x-allow-wildcard-overrides: true`. Keeps core schema strict for API consumers.

jamal: From support side, if we add a checkbox we should instrument telemetry when users override default. Metric idea: `route.lint.override_wildcard_suppressed` with route_id tag.

linter-bot: lint check WL-304: wildcard-header-overrides -> severity=ERROR -> rule_id=WL-304

mira: Proposed plan: 1) quick console change -> show WARN + inline help and an "override" toggle. 2) add vendor extension `x-allow-wildcard-overrides` to schema as optional. 3) unit tests in parser + migration notice in console save flow. 4) telemetry event when override used. I'll open a PR for the console UX part.

alex: Sounds good. Please @cheng for parser tests. Ping when PR open.

cheng: On it — will add tests and a small fuzzer for host patterns to catch edge cases.

deployer: canary deploy scheduled for 03:00 UTC to include the tooltip change (console 1.22.3).
